question: Does plausible direction-split variation change the closure decision — viable set, shortlist, winner — when the SUMO seed is held matched across stress cases?

demand.window_rationale: AM peak: the transfer model claims its largest directional asymmetry there, so it is where direction variation has the best chance of mattering.

stress_case_semantics: Named stress cases from the existing q10/q50/q90 demand artifacts. No probability weight is asserted or implied.
seed_rationale: Four repetitions per condition, following FHWA's Traffic Analysis Toolbox guidance; the same list runs under every stress case.

comparison.primary_cost_basis: candidate minus baseline total time loss, matched per (stress case, seed)

decision_rule.NO: hard failures, viable set, shortlist and winner (or tie) are identical across all stress cases within tolerance
decision_rule.YES: at least one preregistered decision field differs materially
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: timeout, failed run health, or fewer matched pairs than min_pairs_per_cell
